$comment: Sherman's declared capabilities, grouped the way the launch screen shows them.
This file is hand-maintained and engine-agnostic on purpose: it says what
SHERMAN can do, not what a particular engine happens to expose this week.
That is also its risk. A hand-maintained list can drift from reality, and a
launch screen advertising a capability that does not work is exactly the kind
of confident-and-wrong the operating contract forbids.
So the entries divide by what backs them, and smoke.sh check 17 verifies the
verify: 'command'  backed by a first-party shell command. The name must
appear in shell/src/commands.js COMMANDS, and the check
verify: 'engine'   backed by the engine's own tools, reached through the
adapter. Not statically checkable from here; listed
because the adapter grants it, and REMOVED the moment
Nothing goes in this file speculatively. If a capability is planned but not
working, it does not belong here — the launch screen is not a roadmap.
